prediction: Removing GPS north/east ground velocity will not materially degrade recurrent-PPO learning. Velocity remains inferable from integrated IMU acceleration and changes in the held 2 Hz goal-relative GPS position, and MlpLstmPolicy has memory to combine those observations over time.
primary_not_materially_degraded_rule: Across at least three training seeds, the median 50-episode evaluation success rate at 1.5M steps is at least 0.56, no more than 0.10 absolute below the prior 0.66 single-seed result.
secondary_reporting: Report every seed's complete 250k-spaced learning curve and median shaped return.
Report the median final success rate across training seeds with a training-seed bootstrap interval.

disconfirmation_rule: A median final success rate below 0.56 is a substantially degraded, disconfirmed prediction and must be reported without post-hoc reinterpretation.
